title: FieldCalculationMap
description: Performs mathematical calculations on numeric fields using NCalc expressions during migration.

ApplyTo.description: A list of Work Item Types that this Field Map will apply to. Use "*" to apply it to all Work Item Types. A field map with an empty list applies to no Work Item Types and never runs.

Enabled.description: Not used: every configured field map runs for the work item types in `ApplyTo`. To turn a field map off, remove it from `FieldMaps`.

expression.description: Gets or sets the NCalc expression to evaluate. Variables in the expression should be enclosed in square brackets (e.g., "[x]*2").

parameters.description: Gets or sets a dictionary mapping variable names used in the expression to source field reference names.

parsingFallback.description: Gets or sets the parsing fallback.

targetField.description: Gets or sets the target field reference name where the calculated result will be stored.
